# Getting Help

For community questions, feedback, and general discussion, join the [Everglow Discord server](https://discord.gg/pdXvp89Dbp).

For reproducible bugs or documentation problems, please open an issue using the relevant template. Security issues must follow the private reporting process in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

When requesting help, include the page URL, browser and version, device or operating system, and screenshots or console errors where relevant.
